intro_en: You will describe your own home to a new friend in 4-6 connected sentences. You will combine rooms, furniture, location, -д/-т, and байна / байхгүй.
intro_mn: Та шинэ найздаа өөрийн гэрийн тухай 4-6 өгүүлбэрээр холбож ярьж сурна. Өрөө, тавилга, байршил, -д/-т тийн ялгал, байна / байхгүй хоёрыг хамт хэрэглэнэ.

vocab.example_en: There is a table in the kitchen.
There is a bed in the bedroom.
There is a book on the table.
There is a chair under the table.

alt_en: There are three rooms in our home.

sentences.en: There is a bed in the bedroom.

sentences.mn: Гал тогоонд ширээ, дөрвөн сандал байна.
sentences.en: There is a table and four chairs in the kitchen.
alt_en: The kitchen has a table and four chairs.
sentences.mn_latin: Gal togoond shiree, dörvön sandal baina.

sentences.en: There is a vase on the table.
alt_en: A vase is on the table.

sentences.en: There are bags under the bed.
alt_en: There are some bags under the bed.
There is no balcony in our apartment.
Our apartment doesn't have a balcony.

sentences.en: My home is in the city.

sentences.mn: Танай гэрт хэдэн өрөө байна вэ?
sentences.en: How many rooms does your home have?
alt_mn: Таны гэрт хэдэн өрөө байна вэ?
alt_en: How many rooms are there in your home?
sentences.mn_latin: Tanai gert kheden öröö baina ve?

sentences.en: There is no computer in my room.
alt_en: My room doesn't have a computer.

sentences.en: Our home is small but warm.
alt_en: Our home is small, but it is warm.

grammar.title_mn: Гэрээ тайлбарлах: There is/are, in/on/under, My home has...
grammar.explain_en: To say where something is, add -д or -т to the place word: өрөө → өрөөнд (in the room), гал тогоо → гал тогоонд. Some words, like өрөө and гал тогоо, have a hidden н, so they take -нд. Some words take -т, for example гэр → гэрт. Most other words take -д, for example хот → хотод. Then add байна (there is) or байхгүй (there is not). Order: place + thing + байна. For 'on' and 'under' use дээр and доор: ширээн дээр (on the table), орны доор (under the bed). For 'Our home has three rooms', Mongolian says 'In our home, three rooms exist'.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд «байна» гэдгийг There is (нэг зүйл) / There are (олон зүйл) гэж хэлнэ. Эхлээд There is/are, дараа нь зүйл, төгсгөлд нь байрлалыг хэлнэ: There is a bed in the room. Дээр, доор нь on, under: on the table, under the bed. «Манай гэрт гурван өрөө байна» гэдгийг Our home has three rooms гэж хэлж болно. Үгийн дараалал монголоос ялгаатай: байршил төгсгөлд ордог. Үгүйсгэхдээ no эсвэл doesn't have хэрэглэнэ: There is no balcony.

examples.en: There is a bed in the room.
There is a cup on the table.
There is a box under the bed.

fill_blank.translation: There is a table in the kitchen.
fill_blank.explain_en: Гал тогоо ends in a long vowel, so the form is -нд: гал тогоонд = in the kitchen.
fill_blank.explain_mn: «Гал тогоо» урт эгшгээр төгссөн тул -нд залгаж «гал тогоонд» болно.

fill_blank.explain_en: To say something does not exist or is not there, use байхгүй.

fill_blank.translation: There is a book on the table.
fill_blank.explain_en: дээр means on or above. доор means under.
fill_blank.explain_mn: «Дээр» нь on, «доор» нь under гэсэн утгатай.

dialogue.speaker: Анна
dialogue.mn: Сайн уу, Болд! Чи хаана амьдардаг вэ?
dialogue.en: Hi, Bold! Where do you live?
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain uu, Bold! Chi khaana amidardag ve?

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.en: I live in Ulaanbaatar, in an apartment.

dialogue.speaker: Анна
dialogue.mn: Танай орон сууцанд хэдэн өрөө байна вэ?
dialogue.en: How many rooms does your apartment have?
dialogue.mn_latin: Tanai oron suutsand kheden öröö baina ve?

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Хоёр өрөө, гал тогоо байна. Тагт байхгүй.
dialogue.en: There are two rooms and a kitchen. There is no balcony.
dialogue.mn_latin: Khoyor öröö, gal togoo baina. Tagt baikhgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Ор, шүүгээ байна. Орны доор хайрцаг байна.
dialogue.en: There is a bed and a wardrobe. There is a box under the bed.
dialogue.mn_latin: Or, shüügee baina. Orny door khairtsag baina.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Ширээ, дөрвөн сандал байна. Манай гэр жижиг боловч дулаахан.
dialogue.en: There is a table and four chairs. Our home is small but warm.
dialogue.mn_latin: Shiree, dörvön sandal baina. Manai ger jijig bolovch dulaakhan.

culture_note.en: In Ulaanbaatar many people live in apartments in big buildings, while many others live in a ger in a ger district with a small yard. Mongolians often welcome guests warmly and may offer tea or snacks, so talking about your home is a friendly way to get to know someone.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарт олон хүн өндөр барилгын орон сууцанд амьдардаг бол бусад нь гэр хороололд хашаатай гэрт амьдардаг. Монголчууд зочноо дотноор угтаж, цай, зууш өгдөг тул гэрийнхээ тухай ярих нь танилцах найрсаг арга юм.

review.notes: Mostly good; the main real errors are the missing genitive in 'Ор доор', an inaccurate suffix rule in the grammar explanation, and inconsistent speaker names.

opus_fix.notes: The lesson is mostly sound. I corrected the -нд rule in the grammar explanation and replaced the malformed fill-in-the-blank options with real case forms.

changes.why: The -нд rule was wrong: diphthongs take -д (далай → далайд). -нд comes from a hidden н.
The wrong options used malformed forms (тогоооос, тогоотай) instead of real case forms.
